load_equilibrium_from_uri: load an IMAS equilibrium IDS from a URI or file path with optional DD version conversion
build_geometry_from_single_slice: build intermediate geometry dict from a single time slice of an IMAS equilibrium IDS
build_geometry_from_IMAS: build a mapping of time to geometry intermediates for all time slices in an IMAS equilibrium IDS
build_geometry_from_single_IMAS_slice: build geometry intermediates for a single IMAS equilibrium slice by time or index
test_geometry_extraction: test geometry extraction from IMAS equilibrium IDS including flux, current, and boundary profiles
